Section_5.text: Technical Strategy and Approach

We propose a modern, standards-aligned Security Operations capability delivering 24/7 monitoring, rapid incident response (≤ 1 hour for high-severity incidents), and an enterprise-grade SIEM/SOAR platform. The solution is designed for high availability, scalability, and compliance with ISO/IEC 27001. It integrates seamlessly with existing IT operations, cloud platforms, and business applications, and establishes clear governance with the CISO, IT Operations Manager, Compliance Officer, Legal, and Procurement.

Key outcomes:
- Always-on SOC with follow-the-sun coverage and defined SLAs.
- SIEM/SOAR implementation with detection engineering mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and CIS Controls.
- IR playbooks meeting ≤ 60-minute response time for Sev-1 and integrated legal/forensics workflows.
- ISO 27001-aligned processes, artifacts, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
Technical Architecture
Figure 1: Security Operations Architecture (described) - Ingestion Layer: Syslog/HTTPS agents, cloud-native connectors, endpoint/EDR telemetry. Edge collectors deployed per site/VPC/VNet.
- Stream/Parse Layer: Normalization to a common schema (e.g., Splunk CIM or Elastic Common Schema), enrichment (GeoIP, asset/CMDB, threat intel STIX/TAXII).
- SIEM Core: Correlation rules, UEBA, ML-driven anomaly detection, detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
- SOAR/Automation: Playbooks for triage, containment (EDR isolate, firewall rules), evidence collection, ticketing/notification.
- Data Lake/Storage: Hot/warm/cold tiers with lifecycle policies, WORM options for compliance, cross-region backup.
- Threat Intelligence: Commercial and open-source feeds, MISP/TAXII ingestion, indicator scoring/de-duplication.
- Case Management/IR: Integrated ITSM (ServiceNow/Jira), incident taxonomy, chain-of-custody, evidence vault.
- Governance and Reporting: Executive dashboards for CISO, operational KPIs for IT Ops, compliance reports for audits.
- Identity and Access: SSO/MFA with RBAC and just-in-time elevated access.
- HA/DR: Multi-AZ active-active for SIEM analytics; RPO ≤ 15 min, RTO ≤ 2 hours.
System Requirements and Specifications
Functional Requirements
- 24/7 SOC monitoring and triage across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, email, and application layers.
- SIEM correlation and UEBA with MITRE ATT&CK-aligned use cases.
- IR within 1 hour for Sev-1 (containment decision and initial actions), per RFP.
- Automated playbooks for containment, notifications, and evidence capture.
- Threat hunting, purple-team exercises, and continuous detection engineering.
- Compliance reporting (ISO 27001, audit trails, control effectiveness).
Non-Functional Requirements
- Availability: ≥ 99.9% SIEM/SOAR service availability.
- Performance: End-to-end detection latency ≤ 5 minutes for priority log sources; alert to action automation < 2 minutes.
- Scalability: Horizontal scaling to ≥ 100k EPS with burst handling (autoscales on cloud).
- Retention: 365 days searchable; 1–7 years cold archive (policy-driven).
- Security: Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2/1.3), at rest (AES-256), FIPS 140-2 validated crypto modules where available.
- Data Residency: Data stored in approved regions; data classification and masking for PII/PHI.
Service Levels
- MTTD (Sev-1): ≤ 15 minutes.
- MTTR Initial Response (Sev-1): ≤ 60 minutes (Incident Commander engaged, containment initiated).
- Triage Response (Sev-2): ≤ 2 hours.
- Use Case False Positive Rate: < 5% after tuning period.
- Log Onboarding SLA: Critical sources within 2 weeks of project phase start.

Section_6.text: Financial Proposal
Executive Summary
This financial proposal supports the RFP requirement for 24/7 SOC monitoring, SIEM implementation, 1-hour incident response, and ISO 27001 compliance enablement.
We provide two pricing options to align with budget preferences while maintaining the same service-level commitments:
- Option A: Fixed-Fee Managed Security Subscription (predictable OpEx).
- Option B: Hybrid Consumption Model (lower base with variable usage and incident overages).
Payment terms align with the provided contract guidelines: Net 30 days after invoice approval, milestone-based payments for implementation, and a 10% retention on project invoices until completion.
Pricing Model Options
Option A: Fixed-Fee Managed Security Subscription (Recommended)
Scope: End-to-end 24/7 SOC, SIEM deployment and management, incident response (1-hour SLA), threat intelligence, compliance reporting, and ISO 27001 control mapping support.
Commercial profile:
- One-time implementation fee (CapEx): $150,000
- Recurring managed service fee (OpEx): $58,250 per month
- Annual Recurring: $699,000
- 3-Year TCO (no escalation): $2,247,000
Option B: Hybrid Consumption Model
Scope: Same as Option A, with variable/usage-based charges to optimize for lower baseline consumption.
Commercial profile:
- One-time implementation fee (CapEx): $120,000
- Base managed service fee (OpEx): $42,000 per month
- Variable usage:
- SIEM data ingest above 50 GB/day: $35 per GB/day per month
- Incident response hours beyond included 20 hours/month: $225 per hour
- Typical annual range (depending on usage): $504,000–$624,000
- 3-Year TCO illustrative (assuming $47,000/month average): $1,812,000

Assets: ~1,500 endpoints, 150 servers, 25 network devices, 2 cloud accounts.
SIEM data ingest: ~50 GB/day (average), 1-year hot storage; 2-year cold storage.

MDR agents deployed to all endpoints and servers.
